episodes.synopsis: Goro moves back to Mifune. Komori is glad to have the chance to play baseball with him again, only for Goro to reveal he now plays soccer.
episodes.title: He Returns...

episodes.synopsis: The delinquents have left the baseball team, but none of the former members return. Goro's words inspire Komori and Obayashi to recruit new members.
episodes.title: There is one dream!

episodes.synopsis: Goro's story inspires the delinquents to get serious about baseball again. Goro goes to see the reborn Mifune East Junior High baseball team play.
episodes.title: The Baseball Club Starts!

episodes.synopsis: Goro joins the baseball team. To gear up for the summer tournament, he seeks a game against Tomonoura Junior High, where he meets his old pal Toshiya.
episodes.title: Rivals Reunite

episodes.synopsis: Mifune East falls behind in round one of the tournament because Goro shows up late, but his off-speed pitches gets hitters out in fine fashion.
episodes.title: Toshiya's Past

episodes.synopsis: Mifune East faces Seibukan in round two. Goro has a perfect game going through 4 2/3 innings, enthralling a high school scout in the crowd.
episodes.title: The Recruiter's Conspiracy

episodes.synopsis: Toshiya, Tomonoura's captain, proposes a bet to Goro that raises the stakes for their teams' showdown, but Goro gets goaded into a rash of mistakes.
episodes.title: Powerful Rival! Tomonoura

episodes.synopsis: Goro and Yamane hit back-to-back home runs, rattling Toshiya. Seeing his teammates band together, Toshiya realizes he'd forgotten the joy of baseball.
episodes.title: For What Reason...

episodes.synopsis: Toshiya takes the mound and freezes Miyamoto with his fastball. After encouragement from Goro, Miyamoto swings the bat, with unexpected results.
episodes.title: The End of the Battle

episodes.synopsis: Goro is set on getting into Kaido High's baseball club with Toshiya after their junior high affiliate crushes him. The Mifune East boys hit the beach.
episodes.title: A Fresh Resolve

episodes.synopsis: Goro, Toshiya and Komori all pass the first two stages of Kaido High's harsh skills test, but Toshiya and Komori are then pitted against each other.
episodes.title: The Narrow Gate to Kaido

episodes.synopsis: The skills test ends with a five-on-five tournament. Goro is happy to be on Toshiya's team, but is looked down upon for coming from an obscure school.
episodes.title: Ticket to Kaido

episodes.synopsis: Goro and Toshiya pass the skills test and must now take an academic exam. But Goro isn't used to studying, and he ends up being late to the exam.
episodes.title: See Ya...

episodes.synopsis: Goro and Toshiya get into Kaido High and proudly join the baseball club. They go to a school facility on a small island for six months hard training.
episodes.title: The Island of Dreams

episodes.synopsis: After three months at the training facility, Goro has grown strong. The coaches announce an aptitude test to determine the players' positions.
episodes.title: The Requirements of a Pitcher

episodes.synopsis: In a final exam to decide who will leave the island to join the second team, Goro is as free-spirited as ever. Onuki, who had quit the team, shows up.
episodes.title: A Genuine Baseball Kid

episodes.synopsis: Coach Suo declares Goro will pass the test only if he can retire the opposing lineup in order, but Goro has come further than anyone imagined.
episodes.title: A Short Summer Break

episodes.synopsis: The first-year scholarship team intentionally spots the Dream Island team a three-run lead. The insult fills Goro's team with renewed determination.
episodes.title: An Unpleasant Baseball

episodes.synopsis: Goro takes the mound, the team's expectations on his back, and gets back-to-back K's. As the Dream Island team is battling back, Mayumura shows up.
episodes.title: The Scholars' Ability

episodes.synopsis: Toshiya hangs in against Akutsu by fouling off his knuckle balls. Shizuka kicks Akutsu off the team for focusing only on his competitive pride.
episodes.title: Goro VS Manual Baseball!

episodes.synopsis: Down by one with two outs in the bottom of the 9th, Kokubu hits a home run to tie the game. With a walk-off win on the line, Mayumura takes the mound.
episodes.title: Together with You

episodes.synopsis: Shizuka advises Goro to quit the team based on an incident from her past. When he learns what happened, he takes his appeal straight to the top.
episodes.title: Kaido's Secret

episodes.synopsis: Chief Manager Egashira plots to make Goro into a Koshien star as a prop to boost Kaido's image. When Goro is told, his reaction stuns everyone.
episodes.title: Egashira's Expectations

episodes.synopsis: In Goro's second year at Kaido, Momoko gives birth to a girl. With his send-off game against the first team at hand, Goro tells Shigeno his decision.
episodes.title: Varsity Challenge

episodes.synopsis: In his send-off game, Goro is perfect through 6 innings, but starts losing speed on his fastball. In the 7th, he gives up a hit and gets into trouble.
episodes.title: With My Own Two Feet

episodes.synopsis: Toshiya's home run ties the game, but in the 8th, the scholarship players refuse to take the field on defense, and the game takes an unexpected turn.
episodes.title: Goodbye!
